projects.title: DevDash
projects.description: A productivity dashboard for developers to track tasks, goals, and inspiration. Built to bring focus to daily development work with a clean, distraction-free interface.
projects.challenges: Designing a dashboard that was information-dense yet visually calm was the core challenge. Balancing real-time updates with performance, especially when multiple widgets were updating simultaneously, required careful state management and debouncing strategies.
projects.learnings: Learned the value of progressive disclosure in UI design — showing less upfront but making everything reachable. Also deepened my understanding of optimistic UI updates and how to handle failure states gracefully.

projects.title: SnapFeed
projects.description: A photo-sharing app with uploads, a feed, and social features. Inspired by the simplicity of early Instagram, focused on fast image delivery and smooth interactions.
projects.challenges: Handling large image uploads efficiently while maintaining a smooth user experience was the biggest hurdle. Implementing a masonry grid that reflows correctly across screen sizes also required significant iteration.
projects.learnings: Gained hands-on experience with Cloudinary's transformation API for responsive images. Understood the tradeoffs between client-side and server-side pagination for media-heavy feeds.

projects.title: NoteNest
projects.description: A note-taking app with categories and local storage support. Designed for speed — open it, write, and it's saved instantly without any account required.
projects.challenges: Building a reliable offline-first experience without a backend was deceptively complex. Handling data migrations when the schema changed between app versions required careful thought.
projects.learnings: Explored the full capabilities of IndexedDB for structured client-side storage. Learned how to design apps that work entirely offline and sync gracefully when connectivity returns.

projects.title: FitTrack
projects.description: A fitness tracker that logs workouts and progress visually. Helps users stay consistent by making their improvement tangible through charts and streaks.
keyFeatures: Workout logging with sets and reps
projects.challenges: Designing the data model for flexible workout logging — supporting both weighted exercises and bodyweight movements — took multiple iterations. Rendering performant charts with large datasets was also a key concern.
projects.learnings: Developed a deeper appreciation for data normalization in MongoDB. Learned how to use virtualization techniques to keep chart performance smooth even with months of historical data.

projects.title: CodeCritic
projects.description: A code snippet review tool with comments and upvotes. Lets developers share code for peer feedback in a focused, distraction-free environment.
projects.challenges: Implementing inline comments that attach to specific line numbers was technically complex, especially when code was edited after comments were added. Keeping comment positions accurate required a diff-aware anchoring system.
projects.learnings: Learned about code diffing algorithms and how IDEs manage comment anchoring. Also got comfortable integrating Supabase's realtime subscriptions for live comment updates.

projects.title: InspoQuote
projects.description: A daily inspiration quote generator with save and share options. A small but polished utility focused on delightful micro-interactions.
projects.challenges: Keeping the share flow frictionless across different platforms (Twitter, WhatsApp, clipboard) while handling the varying format requirements of each was trickier than expected.
projects.learnings: Appreciated how much polish comes from small details — transitions, haptic-like feedback, and copy confirmation toasts. This project reinforced that micro-interactions significantly impact perceived quality.

projects.title: Blogify
projects.description: A minimalist blogging platform with Markdown support and a comment system. Built for writers who want to focus on content without the overhead of large CMS platforms.
projects.challenges: Implementing nested comment threads with efficient database queries was the most demanding part. Avoiding N+1 query problems while keeping the schema flexible for deep nesting required recursive CTEs in PostgreSQL.
projects.learnings: Gained solid experience with Prisma's relation queries and PostgreSQL recursive queries. Also learned the importance of slugs and metadata for SEO from the start of a project rather than retrofitting them later.
